title: CSR Communication in Mining Regions
subtitle: 5-Year Empirical Comparative Study across Chhattisgarh & Jharkhand
description: Comprehensive comparative study evaluating CSR communication effectiveness, channel preference, and community trust across 10 mining districts. Involved 400 beneficiary surveys and 40 in-depth stakeholder interviews.
impact: Identified critical 26-point local dialect gap; established that verbal community meetings outperform printed reports by 3.4x in awareness creation.

title: CSR Communication Effectiveness in Tribal Communities
subtitle: Fieldwork Analysis across 10 Districts
description: Specialized fieldwork investigation into indigenous linguistic barriers in corporate social disclosure, evaluating education and healthcare interventions.
impact: Formulated recommendations for local dialect integration in CSR extension work.

title: Five-Pillar Framework Development
subtitle: Normative Analytical Model
description: Developed a comprehensive evaluation model categorizing CSR communication governance into Strategy, Participation, Transparency, Feedback, and Impact Assessment.
impact: Published in International Communication Gazette & Governance Review.

title: ESG Communication Framework
subtitle: Global Corporate Standards & Local Community Perceptions
description: Investigating alignment between international ESG disclosure frameworks (GRI, SASB) and grass-root community expectations in developing nations.

title: AI for Sustainability Communication
subtitle: Automated Transparency & Dialect Translation in Development Communication
description: Proposed project testing generative AI models for translating technical ESG reports into accessible indigenous audio-visual formats.
impact: Targeting Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions / Humboldt Postdoctoral Fellowships.
